source: foundation/BACKLOG-UX.md — bloc JSON global des configurations validées de session
objective: Create a DOM-free session configuration registry that stores validated module configurations by stable key, tracks revisions/reference state, exports/imports a versioned global JSON payload and produces copy-safe text without modifying PresetManager or individual Studios.

coordination.preset_manager: Existing PresetManager remains unchanged and keeps module-local preset semantics.
coordination.studios: Theme/QR/Header/Table/JSON Studios remain unchanged; they can publish validated config snapshots later.
coordination.parallel_agents: No session-config registry file or lock found before reservation.

notes: No download/copy DOM API in this lot; only deterministic JSON payload/text generation.
